extracted.name: Coco Mango Waffles (sugar-free)
extracted.description: Originally made this for my little one. Now shared to you. If you want similar recipes, follow us at IG: littleavaeats
instruction_lines: Blend all wet ingredients and coconut flakes until smooth.
In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
Add blended mixture to dry ingredients, mix gently. Rest 10 minutes.
Heat waffle maker/pan, brush with oil or butter.
Drop coin-sized batter, cook 2 minutes per side or until golden.

NOTE: Flour amount varies with main ingredient's moisture and any addition. Start with 1 tbsp and gradually add as needed. Stop when batter thickens but still flowy, if too thick add a splash of milk to thin out. -- This recipe makes 11-12 mini pancakes/waftec
